[1/3] One-click start: single primary CTA, start-and-begin in one click, resume label when active

impact_assessment.why: The home screen had duplicate start buttons and the UI never dispatched begin, so a clicked session stayed idle.
impact_assessment.benefits: A single obvious action starts real practice immediately and removes a dead-end state.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: start button becomes the primary entry point; dependency: none; concurrency: store start+dispatch emits twice; state: active session must resume rather than restart.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Start and begin are one callback, resume is explicit, and a jsdom test asserts the first block reaches running.

[1/4] Persist and restore an active session from a validated local snapshot, with resume from home

impact_assessment.why: A reload or WebView kill currently loses in-progress practice, which breaks the measurement loop on mobile and makes the one-click path fragile.
impact_assessment.benefits: Sessions survive reloads and process restarts; resume uses the same deterministic engine state; no server or account is needed.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: session store gains restore(); dependency: none; concurrency: snapshot writes must be throttled to avoid blocking the frame loop; state: untrusted localStorage must never crash the app.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Versioned snapshot with a structural guard, throttled saves, restore-only-when-valid, and tests for corruption, round-trip hash equality and clearing on completion.

[1/4] Critical audit of CyberPulse behavioral-psychology docs; adopt autonomy, competence, implementation intentions, transparent progress; reject variable-ratio rewards, near-miss amplification, loss-framed stakes, deadlines and combo multipliers

impact_assessment.why: The user asked to integrate CyberPulse's literature review, but that review is a game-engagement rationale and several mechanisms are implicated in gambling harm.
impact_assessment.benefits: A defensible engagement layer that supports practice without manipulating users or contaminating training measurement.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: engagement mechanics become product rules; dependency: none beyond existing React/local storage; concurrency: weekly summary and session state are independent; state: new intention and settings keys must migrate safely.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Versioned local storage with fallbacks, explicit evidence audit, adoption/rejection tests, and product rules R27-R30.
